setting: Two students are discussing a problem with their dormitory room.
narrator_intro: Listen to a conversation between two roommates.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: Hey, can we talk about the room for a second? I've been getting maybe four hours of sleep because of your alarm going off at five every morning.

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: Oh, sorry about that, I didn't realize it was waking you up too. I have swim practice before class, so I set it early to have time to get ready.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: I figured it was something like that. I'm not asking you to change your schedule, I just need a way to not hear it.

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: That's fair. I could switch it to vibrate mode and keep the phone under my pillow. Would that work?

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: That should be fine. Also, would you mind not turning the lights on when you get dressed? Maybe just use your phone flashlight or something dimmer?

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: Sure, that's an easy fix. Honestly, I appreciate you bringing this up directly instead of just being annoyed about it.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: I almost asked to switch rooms, but I figured we could probably work it out first.

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: I'm glad you did. Let's try this for a week and see how it goes. If it's still an issue, we can talk to the resident advisor about other options.

narrator_outro: Now get ready to answer the questions.

questions.narrator_text: What is the main problem being discussed?

options.text: The man wants to change roommates
The woman is being disturbed by the man's morning routine
The man is upset about noise from the woman
Both students want to move to a different dorm

questions.explanation: The woman explains she is losing sleep because of the man's alarm and the lights he turns on.
questions.correctAnswer: The woman is being disturbed by the man's morning routine

questions.narrator_text: Why does the man wake up early?

options.text: He has swim practice before class

questions.explanation: He states he has swim practice before class and sets his alarm early to prepare.
questions.correctAnswer: He has swim practice before class

questions.narrator_text: What two changes does the man agree to make?

options.text: Change his class schedule and buy a lamp
Move his alarm later and study elsewhere
Talk to the resident advisor and switch beds
Put his phone on vibrate and avoid turning on the lights

questions.explanation: He agrees to switch the alarm to vibrate and to avoid using the overhead light while getting dressed.
questions.correctAnswer: Put his phone on vibrate and avoid turning on the lights

questions.narrator_text: What can be inferred about the woman's attitude toward the situation?

options.text: She would rather avoid conflict altogether and say nothing
She thinks the man is doing this on purpose
She prefers addressing the issue directly before considering other options
She is angry and wants to end the roommate arrangement immediately

questions.explanation: She says she almost asked to switch rooms but decided to try working it out directly first.
questions.correctAnswer: She prefers addressing the issue directly before considering other options
